title: Pitches from women that emphasize the long-term security and future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.
Female borrowers who include a specific note about the loan photo may fund faster.
Female borrowers who use a standardized or nearly identical narrative structure may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include the specific number of children in their pitch may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide precise quantities of assets or costs may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who specify the number of children in their pitch fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention being a widow or refugee may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their husband or spouse may fund more slowly.
Pitches from women that contain explicit gratitude markers directed at the lenders are associated with slower funding speeds.
Female borrowers who specifically mention funding children's college education may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
